questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational storage for products, carts, customers, and orders.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Managed relational database for transactional store data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for product photos and other store media; also supports Azure Functions storage requirements.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Choose only if the application does not need persistence or associated storage.

questions.rationale: A shop typically persists catalog and order data and serves product imagery; Azure Functions also needs an associated storage account.
